description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to Orleans clustering using ZooKeeper, including configuration options, membership table implementation, and gateway list provider.

classes.name: ZooKeeperClusteringSiloOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for ZooKeeper clustering silos, including connection string.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProviderOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for ZooKeeper gateway list provider, including connection string.

classes.name: ZooKeeperHostingExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for setting up ZooKeeper clustering in Orleans client and silo builders.

classes.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
classes.description: Implementation of IMembershipTable using ZooKeeper for Orleans membership management.

classes.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Provides a list of gateways for Orleans clients using ZooKeeper, implementing IGatewayListProvider.

methods.name: UseZooKeeperClustering
methods.description: Extension methods to configure Orleans client or silo builders to use ZooKeeper clustering with optional configuration actions.

methods.name: ZooKeeperBasedMembershipTable
methods.description: Constructor and methods for managing membership entries in ZooKeeper.

methods.name: ZooKeeperGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor and methods for providing gateway list information via ZooKeeper.
